sequence.model_input_vector: x_t is an 8-vector with the named channel coordinate set to its event amplitude and all other coordinates zero; UNUSED_4..UNUSED_7 are always zero

order_bit.distribution: balanced 2x2 crossing; exact ordinal construction is specified in splits

target.rule: 1 iff order_bit == gap_bit, where order_bit 0 means A_then_B and gap_bit 0 means 1 TU; otherwise 0

matched_multiset_invariant: Each primary episode contains exactly one A, one B, one N, and one D.
Within each 16-example block, all cells share event amplitudes and reward-delay assignment; every class cell has an identical event-symbol multiset.
The four order-by-gap cells differ only in temporal arrangement; the target is the XNOR of order_bit and gap_bit.
For any fixed episode, every arm receives the same physical events, amplitudes, and target.

noise.symbol_order: balanced_AB_or_BA by exact block cell assignment; independent of target and physical gap

uncorrelated_label_control.target_bit: exact block-cell bit independent of order and physical gap

overflow_control.injection: lifecycle-only ledger boundary fixture; not nine task input receptions

rng.draw_key_fields: UTF-8 bytes of L64-R3|seed|split|block_ordinal|draw_name|draw_ordinal; fields are ASCII decimal or fixed ASCII names and contain no pipe characters
rng.pairing: same seed, split, block, event ordinal, physical stream, target, reward delay, and noise draws across all arms; arm E transforms only its decoder-visible gap feature
rng.arm_e_permutation_bit: (cell_permutation_bit + seed_index_0_based + split_code) mod 2; split_code=0 for train, 1 for evaluation; fixed per episode; cell_permutation_bit=floor(cell/2) mod 2 for primary cells, cell mod 2 for uncorrelated cells, and floor(local_audit_ordinal/4) mod 2 for reward-audit cells
rng.serialization: generated event records use UTF-8 JSON with LF newlines, sorted object keys, and no insignificant whitespace; protocol and fixture artifact identities hash their exact checked-out bytes

training.cell_assignment: cell=local_ordinal mod 16; order_bit=floor(cell/8); gap_bit=floor(cell/4) mod 2; permutation_bit=(floor(cell/2) mod 2 + seed_index_0_based) mod 2; repetition=cell mod 2; target=1 iff order_bit==gap_bit; each block crosses all eight order/gap/permutation combinations twice
training.amplitude_noise_assignment: delta and nu are SHA-256 named draws keyed by seed, split, block_ordinal=floor(local_ordinal/16), and independent draw names; every cell in one block shares the same amplitudes
training.reward_delay_assignment: block_ordinal mod 7 selects [0,1,8,9,15,16,withheld]; all 16 examples in a block share assignment; because each block has eight examples per class, every class has equal counts at each delay

evaluation.cell_assignment: first 1200 local ordinals form 75 blocks of 16; cell=local_ordinal mod 16; order_bit=floor(cell/8); gap_bit=floor(cell/4) mod 2; permutation_bit=(floor(cell/2) mod 2 + seed_index_0_based + 1) mod 2; repetition=cell mod 2; target=1 iff order_bit==gap_bit; each order/gap cell has 300 examples and each permutation is balanced within that cell
evaluation.uncorrelated_assignment: next 400 local ordinals form 25 blocks of 16; cell=local_ordinal mod 16; order_bit=floor(cell/8); gap_bit=floor(cell/4) mod 2; target=floor(cell/2) mod 2; permutation_bit=(cell mod 2 + seed_index_0_based + 1) mod 2; all order/gap/target/permutation combinations occur once per block
evaluation.reward_audit_schedule: for local audit ordinal j=0..199, delay is 0 TU if floor(j/100)=0 else 16 TU; target=j mod 2; order_bit=floor(j/2) mod 2; gap_bit=order_bit if target=1 else 1-order_bit; permutation_bit=(floor(j/4) mod 2 + seed_index_0_based + 1) mod 2; 50 examples per target/delay and balanced order within each group

input_by_arm.C_linear_temporal: eight-dimensional event-driven exponentially decayed amplitude trace
input_by_arm.D_nonlinear_pcn: four-dimensional inferred latent z after final input
input_by_arm.E_permuted_gap_pcn: same latent interface as D using decoder-view gap

readout.decision: class 1 iff p > 0.5; tie p == 0.5 predicts class 0
readout.classification_loss: 0-1 loss, 1[predicted_class != evaluator_target]; balanced accuracy is primary metric
readout.training_surrogate: three-factor reward-modulated perceptron update defined in learning

arms.features: R2 bounded PCN latent plus five-parameter binary readout
arms.learning: online local predictive update plus delayed reward-modulated readout update

arms.features: same topology and parameters as D, with episode-keyed short/long gap-code permutation

pcn.initialization: V[i,j]=0.25 if i=j; V[i,j]=0.125 if i=j+4; otherwise 0; c=0
pcn.parameter_update: immediate after each event using block-coordinate partial gradient at inferred z; no derivative through inference iterations
pcn.elapsed_time_source: physical inter-event ticks in D; Arm E transformed decoder-view gap only for the A/B pair; all other gaps are fixed 1 TU

decoder.training_state_persistence: parameters persist across episodes within one arm and seed; latent, trace, eligibility, queue, and duplicate-ID state reset only after physical cleanup

learning.predictive_objective: PCN reconstruction objective; distinct from task classification loss and reward
learning.activation: one prediction activation at logical sequence completion for each non-silent primary or uncorrelated episode

eligibility.validity: input reception age <= 8000000 ticks at prediction activation
eligibility.capture: activation snapshots the final readout feature h, predicted class a, prediction identity, and IDs of every still-valid input; each contributing input has an equal share 1/n of the readout eligibility vector; physical age is used only for eligibility admission, not as a numeric decoder/reward feature
eligibility.per_input_eligibility: e_i=(1/n)*(2*a-1)*concat(h,1); only the captured copy may survive input-trace expiry
eligibility.empty_eligible_set: activation has no credit record and any later reward is logged_unattributed

activation_reward.source: evaluator-side correctness oracle, isolated from decoder inference
activation_reward.origin: after the prediction has been irrevocably recorded at sequence completion
activation_reward.payload: signed scalar r only; no target label or condition identifier
activation_reward.outcome_is_arm_dependent: reward identity, origin time, due time, and delivery phase match across arms; signed outcome may differ because each arm prediction may differ under the same target and oracle rule
activation_reward.zero_reward_control: reward origin exists but delivery is withheld

learning.reward_update: theta=clip(theta + 0.01 * sum_i(e_i) * r,-1,1) for readout weights and bias only
learning.arms_without_trainable_readout: A records reward provenance but performs no update
learning.evaluation: reward audit may settle a non-mutating diagnostic ledger; no parameter update or inference-path label is permitted

energy_penalty.charge_count: exactly once per physical input reception

identity.ordinal_format: nonnegative base-10 ASCII with no leading zero except zero

event_lifecycle.duplicate_reward: stable_idempotency_key; duplicate is no-op and counted
event_lifecycle.deadline_semantics: 16 TU measured from activation; reward at exactly deadline is accepted; first tick after deadline is rejected because EXPIRY precedes DELIVERY
event_lifecycle.logical_completion: last input event, or 5000000 ticks after episode start for silence
event_lifecycle.physical_cleanup: at the fixed expiry_tick after reward settled, withheld, or rejected; settled records remain as bounded duplicate guards until cleanup
event_lifecycle.episode_execution: strictly serial; next episode starts only after cleanup

arm_e.transformed_feature: only the first A/B inter-event gap category supplied to the PCN/linear temporal decoder
arm_e.transformation: per-episode seeded bijection on {short=1000000 ticks,long=3000000 ticks}; permutation bit 0 is identity, bit 1 swaps categories
arm_e.permutation_source: deterministic balanced cell schedule: primary floor(cell/2) mod 2; uncorrelated cell mod 2; reward audit floor(local_audit_ordinal/4) mod 2; add zero-based seed index and split_code (0=train, 1=evaluation), then mod 2
arm_e.application_time: at reception of the second A/B event using only current and previous physical timestamps
paired_arm_invariants: D and E have identical physical input identities, amplitudes, physical timestamps, labels, reward origins, reward delivery ticks, reward IDs, and cleanup ticks.
The E mapping is keyed independently per episode, not by class or target.
No future event or evaluator target is needed to compute the transformed gap.
N and D inter-event gaps are fixed 1 TU and are not transformed.
arm_e.control_claim: removes the stable decoder-visible short-versus-long mapping across episodes; does not shuffle physical event order or clock

evaluation_design.primary_metric_definition: 0.5*(TPR+TNR) on 1200 primary episodes; score after frozen prediction and evaluator-only target join
evaluation_design.reward_audit: 200 matched frozen-model episodes, no model mutation; 50 per class at each of two delays 0 and 16 TU; labels remain evaluator-only and reward payloads are inspected only by the non-mutating ledger
evaluation_design.prediction_output: strictly before reward delivery, including delay 0 by phase ordering

statistics.paired_unit: same seed and episode ordinal across arms
statistics.seed_effect: paired per-seed balanced-accuracy difference; report equal-weight mean across seeds

bootstrap.draw_procedure: for each replicate and comparison draw 20 seed indices with replacement using SHA-256 named draws; calculate equal-weight mean of selected paired seed effects

inconclusive: any primary seed lacks either class
more than 1% invalid episodes in any arm-seed
interval includes zero while point threshold is met
fewer than 16 of 20 D-minus-C seed effects are positive
fewer than 16 of 20 D-minus-E seed effects are positive
failure: D balanced accuracy is below 0.55 on the primary endpoint
D-minus-C or D-minus-E mean effect is nonpositive
D has fewer than 10 positive seed effects against C or E
statistics.degenerate_outputs: score exact confusion counts; no epsilon substitution; all-class-one or all-class-zero receives balanced_accuracy=0.5 only when both true classes exist
statistics.missing_or_aborted_run: retain as invalid; no replacement seed; if any arm-seed invalid fraction exceeds 0.01 overall verdict is inconclusive
statistics.test_set_policy: no parameter, threshold, permutation rule, or hyperparameter selection from evaluation results

resources.computational_unit_counting_rule: count persistent task-feature coordinates, PCN reconstruction coordinates, PCN latent coordinates, and one binary readout logit; exclude the eight external input channels, trainable parameter storage, and bounded temporary scratch vectors
resources.pcn_event_operation_bound_derivation: preprediction 64 + 4 inference iterations*(prediction64 + residual_and_q32 + latent_gradient_and_projection84) + postprediction64 + final_q32 + predictive_parameter_update200 + decay_and_state12 = 1092 scalar arithmetic/comparison operations before fixed bookkeeping; ceiling 2048 includes bookkeeping and final readout; maximum tanh=8+4*8+8=48; exp is one local decay plus one final sigmoid, at most 2
resources.runtime_acceptance: later authorized execution must complete within all declared caps; measured wall time <=14400 seconds, peak working set <=2147483648 bytes, one logical core, no GPU/network; otherwise abort without extending budget
abort: any counter exceeds its declared bound
process memory or wall-clock ceiling exceeded

instrumentation.authoritative_existing_energy_proxy: activity-cost-proxy only, with explicit category cost configuration
instrumentation.weighted_aggregate: LWC may be reported only after separate owner approval; always retain raw counters

numerical_verification.clip_boundary_policy: finite-difference interior fixtures only; separate one-sided boundary tests
numerical_verification.verification_status: governance_only_central_difference_executed_for_all_latent_V_and_c_groups; clipping boundary, complete training loop, and efficacy remain untested

forbidden_write_paths: Luna-63C C0-C7 fixtures and W-T-E-N5 evidence
Luna-63C certificates, manifests, and corrective reconciliation

validation_requirements.json_schema_validation: validate the complete protocol against protocol-r3.schema.json with a Draft 2020-12 compliant validator; reject unknown keys, absent required keys, null values, nonfinite numeric tokens, duplicate object keys, and wrong numeric/string types
cross_artifact_validation: protocol/proposal/golden fixture SHA-256 manifest matches exact bytes
timebase reciprocals and every tick conversion agree
all arm parameter counts equal the sum of declared trainable groups
all fixture reward times, expiry, and cleanup derive from the same lifecycle fields
D/E physical-event and reward schedule fields compare byte-for-byte
all numeric protocol values have one authority here; prose references these fields
all training/evaluation ordinals are disjoint and exactly match declared counts
